skill_defects: references/method.md 'Step 3b — Prove CTA independently': the only proof given needs 'Opening net assets × (closing rate − opening rate)' and an opening CTA, but SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' question D asks only for 'closing, average and historical' rates, never the opening rate; and no alternative proof is given for a first translation from acquisition (equity components × (closing − historical) + profit × (closing − average)), so a run cannot tell whether that derivation counts as the independent proof.

references/method.md 'Step 3 — Translation': 'Equity: historical rates' gives no rule for retained earnings, which accumulate at many rates; SKILL.md says 'Never approximate a historical rate without saying so' but neither file says how to build the RE historical rate or what to do when only an acquisition-date rate exists.

SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' has no question on ownership percentage, yet references/method.md 'Both entity scenarios' requires CTA to be 'split between the group and the non-controlling interest'; the 80% only surfaced because a group-structure file happened to be uploaded.
SKILL.md 'Stage 1 — Intake' question F covers loans only; nothing asks for trading intercompany balances or their currency of denomination, which decides whether Step 2 remeasurement applies.

references/method.md 'Step 1 — Determine functional currency' relies on P&L, customer, vendor and bank-currency evidence that the upload checklist in SKILL.md never requests, so on upload the functional currency is always user-asserted only.
sample_defects: Key expects the CTA 'proved independently', but the sample omits what SKILL.md's own upload checklist calls 'Required for the proof' (prior-period translated balances and opening CTA) and the 31 Dec 2024 rate needed by the Step 3b formula; only the profit term 35,000 × (1.27 − 1.255) = 525.00 is provable as the skill defines it.

Only one historical rate (1.31 at 2019-03-01) is supplied for both share capital 100,000 and retained earnings 52,420; using it for RE assumes all RE was earned at the acquisition-date rate, which is implausible for 2019–2024 profits.
fx_rates.csv carries four transaction-date rates (2025-07-10 1.2698, 2025-08-12, 2025-09-18, 2025-09-29 at 1.27) with no transactions in any file to apply them to.

Intake says 'No intercompany loans' but the UK TB carries 1300 Intercompany Receivable – Northbrook Trading 33,220 GBP; the parent's side is not in this sample (the financial-statement-builder sample shows 2300 payable USD 38,000 vs 33,220 × 1.27 = 42,189.40, a 4,189.40 gap if that is the counterpart).
summary: PARTIAL 1/2; rota rejected on content. CTA derived (−5,571.80) but called unproved: sample lacks the opening rate and opening CTA the skill's proof requires.
